legend: Beatrice has a tree $$$T$$$ with $$$n$$$ vertices numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$, each of degree at most three. She considers all possible ways to assign the keys $$$1, 2, \ldots, n$$$ to the vertices, with one key per vertex and each key used exactly once. Let $$$k_i$$$ be the key assigned to vertex $$$i$$$.

After assigning the keys, Beatrice can choose a vertex as the root of $$$T$$$ and designate the children of each vertex as left or right. The resulting tree is a binary search tree if the following conditions hold:
Each vertex has at most one left child and at most one right child.

For every vertex $$$i$$$, if it has a left child, all keys in its left subtree are smaller than $$$k_i$$$. Similarly, if it has a right child, all keys in its right subtree are greater than $$$k_i$$$.

For a fixed assignment of keys, a vertex $$$r$$$ is a valid root if $$$T$$$ can be made into a binary search tree rooted at $$$r$$$ by designating each child as left or right. The search quality of the assignment is the number of valid roots.
For the given tree $$$T$$$, find the sum of the search qualities of all possible assignments, modulo $$$998\,244\,353$$$.
input: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$). The description of the test cases follows.
The first line of each test case contains an integer $$$n$$$, denoting the number of vertices ($$$2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$).

Each of the following $$$n - 1$$$ lines contains two integers $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$, denoting the endpoints of an edge ($$$1 \le u, v \le n$$$; $$$u \ne v$$$). The edges form a tree in which every vertex has degree at most three.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, print the sum of the search qualities of all assignments, modulo $$$998\,244\,353$$$.

legend.ai: Beatrice 有一棵树 $$$T$$$，其中有 $$$n$$$ 个顶点，编号从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$，每个顶点的度数至多为三。她考虑将键 $$$1, 2, \ldots, n$$$ 分配给各个顶点的所有可能方式，其中每个顶点恰好分配一个键，且每个键恰好使用一次。设 $$$k_i$$$ 为分配给顶点 $$$i$$$ 的键。
在分配完键值后，Beatrice 可以选择 $$$T$$$ 的一个顶点作为根，并将每个顶点的子节点指定为左孩子或右孩子。当且仅当满足以下条件时，得到的树是一棵二叉搜索树：
每个顶点至多有一个左儿子和至多一个右儿子。
对于每个顶点 $$$i$$$，如果它有左儿子，则其左子树中的所有键都小于 $$$k_i$$$。类似地，如果它有右儿子，则其右子树中的所有键都大于 $$$k_i$$$。
对于一种固定的键值分配，若可以通过将每个孩子指定为左儿子或右儿子，使得 $$$T$$$ 成为一棵以 $$$r$$$ 为根的二分搜索树，则顶点 $$$r$$$ 是一个合法根。该分配的搜索质量定义为合法根的数量。
给定树 $$$T$$$，求所有可能赋值的搜索质量之和，答案对 $$$998\,244\,353$$$ 取模。

input.ai: 每个测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 $$$t$$$($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$)。接下来是各测试用例的描述。
每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$，表示顶点数量($$$2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)。
接下来的 $$$n - 1$$$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $$$u$$$ 和 $$$v$$$，表示一条边的两个端点($$$1 \le u, v \le n$$$；$$$u \ne v$$$)。这些边构成一棵树，其中每个顶点的度数至多为三。
保证所有测试用例中的 $$$n$$$ 之和不超过 $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出所有分配方案的搜索质量之和对 $$$998\,244\,353$$$ 取模的结果。
